retrieving-the-clue-from-the-turtle.text: If on a friend's boat and the turtle is theirs, or if the clue cap is reached:

steps.text: You have a sneaking suspicion that you would have received [a/an] [clue tier] scroll box.
You can't take that clue scroll from this turtle.

retrieving-the-clue-from-the-turtle.text: If X Marks the Spot is completed:

steps.text: You find a bottle attached to the turtle. It has [a/an] [clue tier] clue scroll inside! You take the bottle and the turtle dives away. You give it a wave goodbye!
